benefits.claim: The product is easy to use.
It is a good ticketing system.

benefits.span: So many apps that can be linked

frictions.claim: It lacks an integrated forms system for others to use to assign tasks.
frictions.span: It doesn’t have integrated forms system that other people can fill in to assign tasks

frictions.claim: There is no way to delete tickets after they are created.
frictions.span: No way to delete the tickets once created
